Description:
This lot includes six vintage glass telegraph insulators primarily manufactured by Hemingray. The collection features three clear insulators and three aqua blue insulators in various shapes and sizes. Clear insulators are marked with "HEMINGRAY" and "U.S.A." The blue insulators bear the Hemingray name and model numbers such as "No. 40" and "No. 12." Glass shows typical age-related wear including minor chips, surface wear, and internal bubbles. Overall, the insulators are in good collectible condition. These items are suitable for collectors interested in industrial glass insulators.
